title: AE2 Better Magnet Card
description: AE2 Better Magnet Card lets the Magnet Card, when installed in an AE2 wireless/portable terminal, send picked-up items straight into the ME network instead of your inventory.
body:
# AE2 Better Magnet Card

AE2 Better Magnet Card adds a **Store to Network** option to the **AE2 Magnet Card** when it is installed in a **Wireless / Portable Terminal**.

When enabled, **items you pick up go straight into your ME network** instead of filling your inventory.

***

## Features

*   **Store to Network** toggle on the Magnet Card
*   Quick toggle from the terminal UI (middle-click the Magnet Card in the upgrade slot)
*   Clear Magnet Card tooltip showing the current state
*   Now you can shift click the magnet card, to move it to its slot
*   Range upgrade cards for the Magnet Card (increase pickup radius)
*   Keybinds to toggle both Magnet and Store to Network
* Configurable keybindings to enable and disable functionality:
    - **Toggle Store into Network**: `Shift` + `;` (Semicolon)
    - **Toggle Magnet**: `Shift` + `Tab`

***

## How to use

1.  Put a **Magnet Card** into your terminal’s **UPGRADES** slot.
2.  Enable **Store to Network**.
3.  Pick up items, they will be stored in the ME network automatically.

***

## Compatibility

*   **Applied Energistics 2** (AE2UEL)
*   **AE2 Wireless Universal Terminal** (AE2WUT)
*   **Baubles**
*   **Botania** (Solegnolia compatibility)
